player_prompt.intro:
Kaɗa Mastermind.
Ka fenti code e ɗon haɗi {code_length} digits, kowɗe digit daga 1 zuwa {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Cikin amsinka, kaɗa iya anɗa kaɗa kaɗa guess a cikin tsarin: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Bayan kowɗe guess, kaɗa yiƴi feedback a cikin tsarin black da white pegs.
Black peg ina nufin digit da ake bukata a cikin mawɗe matsayi, yayin da white peg ina nufin digit da ake bukata a cikin mawɗe matsayi.
Kaɗa ɗon {max_turns} turns don guess code.

invalid_move.wrong_format: You did not respond with a space-separated list of numbers wrapped in square brackets.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ko windi fuu haani laato intejairji je ɗon na.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: A ɗon tammi {guess}. To a foondi feere, foonda nde woore.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: A yiƴi koɗol, o solvi {black_pegs} daga {code_length} pegs kwaɗin
outcome.turn_limit: Limgal waylugo yotti. A footi taƴa {percent} % limɗe je ɗon wooɗi.
